information.description:
The VDB have the most ‘runners of any gang in Night City, of whom these are the most basic. They’re still a significant threat, especially thanks to their layers of ICE and a deadly program list, but these net-lovers aren’t anything particularly special. Often sent into combat alongside a few Malfini or Spirits, and prefer lethal Quickhacks over passive ones.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Voodoo Boys).

description.value: Master hackers who put themselves at risk as they jack into cyberspace to download secrets and infiltrate networks.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

The A-22B Chao is their answer to Arasaka's Yukimura. As the gossip goes, both guns may have been designed by the same engineer, extracted from the Japanese corp on Kang Tao's orders. Whatever the case may be, you can be sure the Chao is easy to use and reload; once the last cartridge is used, the empty mag is auto-ejected.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Snubnose Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 21 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Snub Barrel, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by its user sacrificing their Move Action as long as they have at least one other empty hand.

Range: Snubnose Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Snub Barrel, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

Netrunner armored skinsuit. Can store Cyberdeck and support Interface Plugs. Can't be bought in two pieces. Always worn on both Head and Body Location. Adds one Hardware only Option Slot to connected Cyberdeck. No armor penalty.
A cybernetical replacement leg. Comes with a free foot.

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Adds kinetic actuators to leg internals, allowing for a “double jump.”

Cyberleg Option. Once per Round when the user jumps at least 4m/yds, the distance traveled can be increased by 2m/yds in any direction, including up. Requires two Cyberlegs and must be paired.

Type: Cyberleg
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1
